title: Unclear answers across diagnostics and voice destination prompts
summary: This topic combines unrelated mentions of unclear answers in dealer diagnostics, unanswered customer communication, and voice navigation asking about intermediate destinations.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes a dealer identifying an air-fuel mixture issue but not providing a clear explanation of the root cause.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions include unanswered calls, customers not answering, and voice-system prompts about final versus intermediate destinations without enough context to classify sentiment.

limitations: The sample is dominated by undetermined fragments, so the interpretable sentiment evidence is limited.
This cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as engine diagnostics, customer communication, and navigation voice prompts.
Several fragments are too brief to determine whether they reflect satisfaction, dissatisfaction, or simple factual context.
